scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:host
scripts.build:web: bun run typecheck && bun ../../tools/workspace-dev/scripts/run-task.ts -- bun ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config web/vite.poc.mts
scripts.test: bun run test:web && bun run test:host
scripts.typecheck: bun ../../tools/workspace-dev/scripts/run-task.ts -- bun ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p web/tsconfig.json && bun ../../tools/workspace-dev/scripts/run-task.ts -- bun ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: bun run lint:web && bun tools/rust-task.ts lint
scripts.lint:web: bun ../../tools/workspace-dev/scripts/run-task.ts -- bun ./node_modules/oxlint/bin/oxlint web/src tools web/vite.poc.mts vitest.poc.mts --config ../../.oxlintrc.json --tsconfig web/tsconfig.json
